RRULE = "DTSTART:20230118T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1;WKST=MO"


@pytest.fixture
def event_schedule(event, user):

@pytest.fixture
def organizer_schedule(event, user):

        organizer=event.organizer,
        owner=user,
        export_identifier="dummy_orders",
        export_form_data={"all_events": True, "events": []},
        mail_subject="Test",
        mail_template="Test",
        locale="en",
        timezone="Europe/Berlin",
        schedule_rrule=RRULE,
        schedule_rrule_time=time(2, 30, 0),
        schedule_next_run=now() - timedelta(minutes=5),
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_scheduled_event_export_is_dispatched_and_advanced(event_schedule):
    old_next_run = event_schedule.schedule_next_run
    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as apply_async:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    apply_async.assert_called_once_with(kwargs={'event': event_schedule.event_id, 'schedule': event_schedule.pk})
    event_schedule.refresh_from_db()
    assert event_schedule.schedule_next_run > now()
    assert event_schedule.schedule_next_run != old_next_run


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_scheduled_organizer_export_is_dispatched_and_advanced(organizer_schedule):
    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as apply_async:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    apply_async.assert_called_once_with(
        kwargs={'organizer': organizer_schedule.organizer_id, 'schedule': organizer_schedule.pk}
    )
    organizer_schedule.refresh_from_db()
    assert organizer_schedule.schedule_next_run > now()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_scheduled_export_not_yet_due_is_not_dispatched(event_schedule, organizer_schedule):
    event_schedule.schedule_next_run = now() + timedelta(hours=1)
    event_schedule.save(update_fields=['schedule_next_run'])
    organizer_schedule.schedule_next_run = now() + timedelta(hours=1)
    organizer_schedule.save(update_fields=['schedule_next_run'])
    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as ev, \
            mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as org:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    ev.assert_not_called()
    org.assert_not_called()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_scheduled_export_without_next_run_or_rrule_is_not_dispatched(event_schedule, organizer_schedule):
    event_schedule.schedule_next_run = None
    event_schedule.save(update_fields=['schedule_next_run'])
    organizer_schedule.schedule_rrule = None
    organizer_schedule.save(update_fields=['schedule_rrule'])
    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as ev, \
            mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as org:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    ev.assert_not_called()
    org.assert_not_called()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_scheduled_export_is_not_dispatched_twice(event_schedule):
    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as apply_async:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    apply_async.assert_called_once()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_failed_dispatch_keeps_schedule_due_and_does_not_block_others(event_schedule, organizer_schedule):
    old_next_run = event_schedule.schedule_next_run
    with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async', side_effect=ConnectionError("broker down")), \
            mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as org:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    org.assert_called_once()
    event_schedule.refresh_from_db()
    assert event_schedule.schedule_next_run == old_next_run
    organizer_schedule.refresh_from_db()
    assert organizer_schedule.schedule_next_run > now()
